ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE: 100W PD source + 5A e-marked cable. PCB/thermal/loop/start-up validation required.
NVM: PDO1=5V/0.5A; PDO2=20V/5A; count=2; POWER_ONLY_ABOVE_5V=1; POWER_OK_CFG=2; REQ_SRC_CURRENT=0.
24V constant voltage; automatic load-following from no external load to 60W. Input protection ~4.5A. Single powered corner; no current-sharing claim.
